name: Stick-on bindi (face jewel)
definition: decorative jewel or ornament stuck on the forehead or skin with adhesive, not fixed by chain, pin or piercing.
reason: Memo §9 and tree file it in A3 (K-129) but give no kind; sold as bindis; kumkum and powders stay H1.

name: Surface bar
definition: staple-shaped bar with two upturned ends, made for a surface piercing.
reason: Memo §10 piercing glossary item (†); a fitting form neither straight nor curved barbell; fitting-before-site rule (A-13).

name: Hinged segment ring (clicker)
definition: piercing ring closed by a hinged segment that clicks into place.
reason: Leaf A3.3.2 is named Rings and clickers but holds only the captive bead ring; closure fitting differs, piercing shops sell clickers apart.

name: Circular barbell (horseshoe)
definition: open ring-shaped bar with a threaded or pressed ball or end at each tip.
reason: Harvest note conflates CBR with circular barbells (BM25); different fitting from the captive ring, so its own kind; attest in NK.

name: Ear hanger or weight
definition: heavy hanging piece hooked through a stretched lobe, worn instead of a plug or tunnel.
reason: BM25 lists ear hangers beside plugs, tunnels and tapers; no stretched-ear kind covers a hanging piece.

name: Statement necklace (bib necklace)
definition: necklace built of large fixed ornamental elements, stones or metalwork along its front, not hung from a bail and not a bead strand.
reason: Tanishq and CTF sell plain necklace as product kind; fixed-ornament necklaces fit no A3.4.1 kind; also home for haram.

name: Tennis necklace (rivière)
definition: flexible line of evenly set stones worn round the neck.
reason: Parallel of tennis bracelet A3.5.1.02; Blue Nile-type sellers list it apart; otherwise no home; attest in NK.

name: Hat pin
definition: long ornamental pin with a decorative head, pushed through a hat to hold it to the hair.
reason: Memo §10 † list names hat pin; pinned dress ornament sold and collected under its own name; brooch and lapel pin do not cover it.

name: Shirt stud (dress stud)
definition: ornamental stud that fastens a formal shirt front or a detachable collar through its buttonholes (collar studs included).
reason: Oliver Brown collection is Cufflinks, collars and studs (harvest saw only cufflinks, tie pin); no A3.7.2 kind fits; attest in NK.
